scope.description: Isolated control for the committed-log-replay finding: bootstrap a single voter, become leader, commit five commands, never snapshot (SnapshotThreshold huge, SnapshotInterval 10m), shut down and restart on the same InmemCommitTrackingStore/InmemStore/InmemSnapshotStore with RestoreCommittedLogs left at its default false. Emits only the control setup event and the control result event, so the control is scored independently of the failing mode.
assumptions: RestoreCommittedLogs defaults to false (config.go), so this is the ordinary restart path with identical durable state and identical missing snapshot.
The stores and the bootstrap/commit sequence are the same as in the failing probe, so the only difference is the replay of committed logs at startup.
excluded: No multi-voter cluster, no configuration change, no partitions.

basis.prefix: Real bootstrap, real election, real applies, real shutdown and restart on the same durable stores with a fresh transport; no fabricated log entries or configuration state.

comparisons.description: Control expectation: without replaying committed logs, the restarted node keeps its bootstrapped configuration, isolating the replay as the cause of the loss observed with RestoreCommittedLogs enabled.
